sentences.text: Welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
Even when the weather is cold, Galway shows the Irish heart.
Galway is on the west coast of Ireland.
It is near the Atlantic Ocean.
Rain is part of the city.
The city grew with the sea.
Traditional Irish music fills the air.
This city teaches joy, connection and openness.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English podcast.
See you in the next episode.
